exceptions.reason: Titles, names and secondary lines that truncate to one line with an ellipsis by design (text-overflow: ellipsis in their CSS).
Visually hidden text for screen readers is clipped on purpose.
The command palette's ↵ ↑ ↓ key glyphs, which axe skips as non-text. --muted-foreground on --muted measures 5.0:1 in light and 5.9:1 in dark.

Admin fields and text outside the visible part of the app's scrolling content area (below the fold, or scrolled sideways on phones), where axe can't find a background. lintapple measures the same styles where they are in view.
Sticky headers of columns scrolled out of view in a phone-width table, which axe errors on. They share the style of the headers it measures in view.
Cards show their title as text. At phone width a card whose title is below the fold looks text-free to the check.
